attestations.text: HUANG Tê-kung 黃得功 (T. 滸山, 虎山), d. 1645, June 15, Ming loyalist general, was a native of K'ai-yüan, (Liao-ning), to which place his ancestors had moved from Ho-fei, Anhwei. His original patronymic was Wang 王, but he changed it to Huang when he was adopted by a family of that name.
